Subject: Request: MSA/DPA/SOW + exception process for Futura integration

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looks promising and the team is excited to move forward. Procurement/legal asked me to collect Redwood's standard MSA, DPA and a draft SOW for an initial integration (connector + 90-day pilot). They also requested a list of the exceptions Redwood typically accepts versus the items that require leadership sign-off.

Timeline: procurement is aiming to have a signed agreement and PO by 8/25 if possible. Can you: 1) send MSA/DPA/SOW templates, 2) provide a brief exception matrix (acceptable / needs legal approval / not acceptable), and 3) flag any non-negotiable security or data residency clauses we should be aware of?

Also copying our procurement inbox to streamline review.

Appreciate it — Jill

--
Jill Henson

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-13T09:15:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Futura — quick redline notes and proposed positions

Forwarding Jill's request and our attachments. Internal notes below — rough positions to confirm before we send the exception log to Futura.

----- Forwarded message from Jill Henson <jill.henson@futura.io> -----

(on original email)

Internal (vanessa notes):
- Data residency and retention: Futura wants EU + US residency options for customer data in the pilot. We can accept with DPA addendum and regional routing for keys; mark as "requires legal approval / ops playbook".
- Indemnity and liability cap: They asked for a higher cap. Our default cap is $1M. Recommend counter-proposal: $2M for pilot / $5M for committed enterprise deals with additional SLA terms. Sergio to advise.
- Audit rights / security assessments: We usually allow SOC2 report review and contractually limited audits. Push back on broad on-site audit language; propose remote evidence and scoped controls.
- Subprocessor list / onboarding: Share standard subprocessors; accept with notification and 30-day cure.
- SOW milestone/payment: Request to align milestone 2 (pilot acceptance) with 50% TOC payment; propose 25%/50%/25% schedule.

Action items:
1) Sergio — assemble exception log + suggested language for each item (deadline EOD 8/14).
2) Laura/Vanessa — set 8/14 11am PT for a 30-min call with Futura (Jill) to close open items.

Thanks — vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jill Henson <jill.henson@futura.io>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@futura.io
Date: 2026-08-15T14:05:00Z
Subject: RE: Request: MSA/DPA/SOW + exception process for Futura integration

Hi Jill / team — attaching the exception log requested. I've summarized Redwood's position and proposed language for each item. High-level: most of the asks are reasonable for a pilot; a few items need leadership sign-off (indemnity cap and long-term data residency guarantees).

Key exceptions (summary):
1) Data residency: We can commit to regional processing for pilot with contractual DPA addendum. For multi-region guarantees beyond pilot we'll need an ops onboarding plan and potentially a Dedicated contract.
2) Indemnity / liability: Proposed compromise: $2,000,000 cap for the pilot term; escalate to $5,000,000 for enterprise commitments >$200k ARR. See proposed clause in the attached spreadsheet.
3) Audit scope: Agreed: provide SOC2 Type II report and remote evidence. Reject on-site expansive audits; propose limited, scoped audit with 30 days notice.
4) Subprocessors: provide current list; notify 30 days before changes.

Attached: Futura_exception_log.xlsx (spreadsheet) — columns: clause, Futura ask, Redwood position, proposed redline text, approver_needed.

Next steps:
- If these positions look ok to Futura, we'll circulate clean MSA/DPA/SOW with tracked changes and a DocuSign envelope link.
- For items marked approver_needed, I will capture formal sign-off from legal leadership; timing may add 2–3 business days.

Related links:
- GDrive SOW draft: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cFuturaSOW
- Proposed DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/prepare/3a9f5f

Regards,

From: Jill Henson <jill.henson@futura.io>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-18T10:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: MSA/DPA/SOW + exception process for Futura integration

Thanks, Sergio — the exception log is helpful and mostly aligns with our expectations. A few quick points from procurement/legal: 

- Indemnity cap: Futura's legal prefers a higher cap, but for the pilot we can accept $2M as proposed. We will review the enterprise threshold language for the future.
- SOW milestone/payment: We prefer milestone 2 to be 40% rather than 50% to smooth cashflow. Is Redwood open to 25%/40%/35%?
- Data residency: The DPA addendum language looks fine for the pilot; can you confirm whether key rotation / KMS integration is included in that addendum or will be an ops playbook item after signature?

If you can send a clean set of MSA/DPA/SOW docs with the agreed redlines (and the DocuSign link), we'll route for internal signature and issue the PO. Targeting 8/25 as discussed.

Appreciate everyone's responsiveness.

Best,
Jill Henson
Head of Partnerships (Legal Liaison)
Futura Analytics
